thread:
Ana (PM): Heads-up — need to reforecast mid-Q OKRs. Acme Health (pilot) requires a Dedicated pilot with KMS/HSM + tighter latency SLA. They're pushing a decision in 6w. Can we reprioritize so we can commit?
Jamal (Eng): Quick context: KMS integration + dedicated pool provisioning is non-trivial. Ballpark 4w infra + 2w verification. If we shift that in, embeddings perf work slips.
Kevin (Infra): Bandwidth note: we already have quantization infra on the calendar. We can bump but it'll create knock-on schedule risk unless product signs off.
Sophie (GTM): Acme is flagged as deal w/ high conversion probability. Pilot is conditional on KMS + predictable latency. Losing them likely >$200k ARR. Recommend prioritizing. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Liz (CS): We have a draft pilot contract. Legal can fast-track KMS clauses, support can prep a runbook once scope is locked.
Matt (Head of Product): @Ana can you propose the minimal viable scope to satisfy Acme? Need concrete tradeoffs so we can decide.
Ana (PM): Minimal scope suggestion:
```
Must-have:
- Dedicated GPU pool (2x node size)
- Bring-your-own KMS integration (customer keys)
- SLA target: p95 < 350ms for 512 tokens
- Fallback plan: route to hosted model variant if Dedicated capacity degraded

Can delay:
- Embeddings perf project (move to Q3)
- Batch optimizer alpha release
- Extended observability (detailed token-level cost breakdown)
```
Jamal (Eng): That MVSC looks doable if we reassign two backend sprints and pull one infra engineer. I'll need 2 engineers for ~4w (infra + testing).
Kevin (Infra): Ops/SRE: can provision the Dedicated pool once capacity is freed. Also need autoscaler and network egress rules updated for VPC/KMS. Estimate 1 oncall for pilot weeks.
Product-Bot: OKR update request created: /okrs request #3456 (pending leadership review)
Priya (Finance): Quick finance check — if pilot converts to paid by EOY we expect ~$120k ARR; timing might shift some recognized revenue. Need formal reforecast to quantify Q2/Q3 impact.
Matt (Head of Product): Provisional approve to reforecast and pull embeddings to Q3 given GTM risk. @Ana update OKR owners + EPICs today, include expected engineering delta. We'll review with execs tomorrow.
Ana (PM): Will do. Scheduling a 30m sync 10:30 PT to lock scope and owners. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Sophie (GTM): I'll prep customer comms and a minimal success criteria doc for pilot.
Liz (CS): I'll start the runbook template and support staffing plan.
Jamal (Eng): I'll post a proposed sprint shuffle and resource plan in the thread before the sync.
Kevin (Infra): Noted. Adding a short checklist for KMS prereqs to the meeting agenda.
Ana (PM): Final note — we keep embeddings perf as a critical Q3 OKR; we need to avoid scope creep during the pilot.
Matt (Head of Product): Agreed. If anything slips beyond the agreed MVSC we re-evaluate.
Ana (PM): Thanks all — see you at 10:30.
